This file holds ONLY ${...} env-references — never a bearer token. Claude Code

One long-running HTTP server owns the canonical DB; sessions share it. Loopback
(127.0.0.1) shares only within one host/container — for cross-container sharing
bind a routable host and add it to the network allowlist (see web/network-policy.md).
